event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Defensive bid, chips crushed.
Consumer Confidence printed 103.3 vs 92.5 fc, but that strength never reached semis: SOXX -8.27% and XLK -3.26% dragged QQQ -1.99% while XLV +2.95% and XLP +1.66% caught the protective bid. Tuesday's tape was not risk-on rotation, it was exit from AI hardware.

INDICES — VIX 26.6, elevated, down -1.28% via VIXY.
DIA +0.79%, IWM +0.53%, SPY -0.49%, QQQ -1.99%, SOXX -8.27%. Small beat large by 1.02pp. Most notable cross-asset move: silver -5.32% (SLV) alongside gold -2.27% (GLD), a real liquidation in precious metals. Both SPY and QQQ sit below their 200-day MAs — a CTA sell trigger active.

VOLUME & BREADTH — Vol concentrated where price fell.
SOXX traded 1.6x avg on -8.27% — clear distribution; SLV 1.4x on -5.32%, also distribution. QQQ vol_ratio 1.0x — flat, not capitulation; SPY 1.0x, unremarkable. SPY/QQQ volume does not confirm selling, but neither does it suggest accumulation. Breadth: 69% advancers, 55% above 50DMA, 53% above 200DMA, up/down vol 1.04, 30 new highs vs 9 lows — participation is broad and diverges sharply from the index-level damage, a rotation tape not a correlated selloff.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +2.95%, XLP Staples +1.66%, XLRE Real Estate +1.31%, XLE Energy +0.97%, XLF Financials +0.83%, XLC Comms +0.82%, XLY Discretionary +0.68%, XLB Materials +0.54%, XLU Utilities +0.18%, XLI Industrials -0.53%, XLK Technology -3.26%.
Top industries XBI +6.56%, IBB +5.17%; bottom SMH -7.26%, DRAM -9.22%, WGMI -8.28%. Flows: XLC +$280mm (92p) and XLP +$231mm (83p) led inflows; XLE -$1,142mm (2p) and XLV -$884mm (2p) saw the largest outflows. Healthcare was today's top performer yet bled $884mm over 5 days — short-covering, not conviction. Money flowed into bio/medtech (XBI) and out of semis; SMH +$1,503mm (98p) while SOXX -$3,577mm (0p) tells you the fight is inside the chip complex. Rotation state: 'defensive risk-off'.

POSITIONING — Protection bid everywhere.
SPY PCR 1.80, IWM PCR 3.36 — heavy downside hedging; QQQ skew +12.8% with ATM IV 31.3% prices the tape as fragile. VIX 26.6 sits 4.5pts above its 20d MA (22.1); VVIX 117.4 vs 109.3 MA confirms fear. VIXEQ 50.0 vs VIX 26.6 — a wide single-stock dispersion gap, a rotation tape; MOVE data unavailable.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil up, metals down.
USO +1.55% and UNG +4.67% ran into a -0.50% dollar (UUP), yet GLD -2.27% and SLV -5.32% — metals falling despite dollar weakness signals liquidation, not rate-driven hedging. Next FOMC Dec 9, 2026: Polymarket prices 94% for a 25bp hike, only 4% no change.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 58.5, Neutral.
Movers: TXN -11.25%, MU -11.01%, MRVL -9.10% — all chip names caught in the same semiconductor rout, no single catalyst in feed. Worst 20d momentum: XLK -17.10%. Vol spike QQQE 3.6x on -0.94% = distribution; MDT 2.7x on -4.56% of the Medtech 7, also distribution. Watch: SMH (-7.26%) — +$1,503mm inflow at 98th percentile vs -7.26% price: accumulation fighting the tape; GLD — -2.27% despite UUP -0.50%, dollar-divergence signal; IWM — +0.53% with PCR 3.36 protection demand, small-cap gamma pressure.
